visualCharacteristics: Horizontal rail of 2:3 image tiles on a split ink/ice band with category label, linked title, abstract revealed on hover or + toggle, and round prev/next arrows.
contentPattern: One row per tile: picture cell | content cell with category paragraph, h3 with link, and abstract paragraph(s).
usage: Use to present services or offerings as a slidable rail of linked image tiles.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any set of linked offering tiles by adding one row per tile with image, category, linked heading and abstract.
